946660.rationale: Cairo Criminal Court (New Cairo) case 6838/2025: 28 defendants accused of importing and manufacturing synthetic cannabinoids (750kg). The prosecution demanded death for all on June 11, 2026. Manufacturing or forming a gang carries death, reducible to life (the typical outcome). The defence relies on the Supreme Constitutional Court voiding EDA decree 600/2023, and the forensic chief testified the substances are unlisted analogues, so acquittal is a real possibility.
